title: Omega vs. Ospreay: the returning standard-bearer
summary: Kenny Omega returns to test the man who helped lead New Japan in his absence. Ospreay’s quest for recognition becomes a fight to recover his title and overcome the former ace of the foreign contingent.

chapters.title: Omega takes Ospreay’s championship
chapters.result: Omega defeats Ospreay for the IWGP United States title.
chapters.context: The returning star leaves the current headliner needing both a rematch and an answer to the defeat.

chapters.title: Ospreay wins the Canadian rematch
chapters.result: Ospreay defeats Omega to regain the United States championship.
chapters.context: The joint event brings the rivalry to Omega’s home country, where Ospreay reverses the Tokyo Dome result.
